title: Scholarship Application Timeline & Deadlines
script: Welcome to TalentXcel Career Intelligence. A step-by-step 12-month calendar for winning full-ride funding. Top priorities include Months 1-3: Target Identification & Exams, Months 4-6: SOP Drafting & Reference Letters, and Months 7-9: Official Portal Submission. Early Submission Advantage reaches Higher Funding Probability. Explore verified opportunities at talentxcel dot com today.
